name: LA-04
label: Safe R

key_factors: R+17 district held by Speaker Mike Johnson
Overwhelming money edge: $21M raised vs $269K for Gromlich
Prediction markets price Johnson near certain at ~94%
No public polling or expert ratings; fundamentals drive the call
model.rationale: Johnson pairs a heavily Republican district with the visibility and war chest of a sitting Speaker, and markets price his reelection near certain, while the Democratic field is lightly funded and draws no polling or rater attention. The fundamentals justify a margin a few points beyond the district lean.
model.watch: Only a major national Democratic wave or an unforeseen scandal involving Johnson would put the outcome in doubt.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Louisiana's fourth district is a deeply Republican seat, and its incumbent, Mike Johnson, carries the added profile of Speaker of the House. He has raised roughly $21 million for the race and holds more than $9.6 million on hand, while Democrat Matt Gromlich has raised about $269,000 with little cash remaining. No public polls cover the contest, and no expert raters have flagged it as competitive.

Prediction markets give Johnson about a 94 percent chance of winning, and the district's partisan lean points the same direction. A second Democrat and two minor Republicans are on the ballot under Louisiana's jungle-primary system, which could force a runoff but is unlikely to change the outcome. The forecast rates the race Safe Republican, with Johnson expected to win by a wide margin.
